fee_notes: Initial franchise fee ranges from $2,000 to $100,000 depending on the type of Sushi Counter (On-Site or Commissary Location), whether it is a non-traditional venue (airports, universities, hospitals, office buildings), and certain location characteristics (geography, population, traffic, demographics). Fee is mutually agreed upon and set in the final Franchise Agreement. No initial franchise fee is charged for a Bento Sushi Satellite Location Franchise. Up to 100% financing of the initial franchise fee is available to qualified franchisees. Franchisor reserves the right to reduce the fee when unable to find a franchisee for a location or when the location is a high priority for the Host Facility. All Item 5 fees are non-refundable except the Manual Lease Fee ($500), which is refunded upon return of manuals in good condition.
raw_excerpt: The amount of the Initial Fee ranges from $2,000 to $100,000, depending on many factors. Those factors include: The type of Sushi Counter you open, from the following options: Bento Sushi On-Site Location Franchise, Bento Sushi Commissary Location Franchise - Whether your Sushi Counter is located in a "non-traditional venue," which includes airports, university campuses, hospitals, office buildings, or other location that is different from the typical grocery store setting. - Certain characteristics of your location, including geographical area, people population, traffic patterns, demographics of income, age, and mobility, and other characteristics that we determine. We do not charge an initial franchise fee for a Bento Sushi Satellite Location Franchise.
